title: SynthRCT: Scalable Conditional Deformation Synthesis for Synthetic Repeat CT Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.08627v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In proton therapy, plans are typically optimized on a single planning CT, making robustness evaluation essential under anatomical changes. However, current scenarios often rely on simplified perturbations that poorly capture complex, patient-specific variability. We propose SynthRCT, a scalable conditional generative framework for 3D anatomical deformation synthesis. Based on a conditional variational autoencoder, SynthRCT learns a latent deformation space and decodes sampled latent codes into local stationary velocity fields conditioned on an input anatomy. Local fields are assembled into coherent full-volume transformations, enabling memory-scalable generation for large field-of-view CT data. We validate the approach on respiratory 4DCT data with multiple breathing-phase anatomies per subject. SynthRCT enables patient-specific sampling of plausible anatomical transformations beyond predefined robustness scenarios. Code available at:

translated_title: SynthRCT：用于合成重复CT生成的可扩展条件形变合成框架
translated_abstract: 在质子治疗中，治疗计划通常基于单一的计划CT进行优化，因此在解剖结构变化下的鲁棒性评估至关重要。然而，当前的场景往往依赖于简化的扰动方法，难以捕捉复杂的、患者特异性的解剖变异。我们提出了SynthRCT，这是一个用于三维解剖形变合成的可扩展条件生成框架。基于条件变分自编码器，SynthRCT学习一个潜在形变空间，并将采样的潜在编码解码为以输入解剖结构为条件的局部平稳速度场。这些局部场被组装成连贯的全体积变换，从而实现对大视野CT数据的内存可扩展生成。我们在包含每个受试者多个呼吸期相解剖结构的呼吸4DCT数据上验证了该方法。SynthRCT能够在预定义的鲁棒性场景之外，实现患者特异性的合理解剖变换采样。代码已在公开平台上发布。
tldr: 本文提出SynthRCT，一个基于条件变分自编码器的可扩展生成框架，能够从单一CT合成患者特异性的三维解剖形变，用于生成合成重复CT以支持质子治疗中的鲁棒性评估。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SynthRCT, a scalable conditional generative framework based on a conditional variational autoencoder that synthesizes patient-specific 3D anatomical deformations from a single CT to generate synthetic repeat CTs for robustness evaluation in proton therapy.
